objective: Improve BUKLOD Wall and IGPAT/Reels first-video startup and one-video-ahead playback using existing SDK 57, without adding paid services or changing private-media access or advertisements
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: 2026-11-10 GitHub main source SHA 3ad05357f909a604d6bba15917bf6dde9c2c4ff7 inspected; existing Expo Hosting and Expo production OTA workflows inspected; branch is DEV, not proof of deployed web or installed Android OTA. Owner waives only physical device verification. Vercel build-rate-limit check is separate from canonical Expo Hosting workflow.
chosenApproach: Use progressive private signed-URL preparation that renders the first row before completing all URL signs; preload one next playable row while respecting Data Saver, preserve inline ad rows and quick-edit controls; tune Android video buffering, add privacy-safe startup/rebuffer timing and recognize HLS URL metadata without requiring new backend. Route eventual web deployment through existing Expo Hosting workflow only.
selectionRationale: Current IGPAT waits for all signed URLs before first paint and mounts player only at active index. Existing Expo SDK 57 supports player preload and native buffering. No cost-bearing backend migration is authorized. Independent Vercel status is not a BUKLOD Main Expo Hosting deployment gate.
acceptanceChecks: First IGPAT playable row appears after its own signed access completes, without waiting on entire feed
Stale requests cannot overwrite a newly selected feed; background signing preserves row order
At most the next regular video is warmed; no preloading of ad media, no autoplay of offscreen media
Native data saver disables next-video warm loading; existing video caching is retained
Web quick-edit, play/pause, native two-times long-press, Wall media fit and ads remain intact
User-specific Supabase media access stays private and URLs are never sent to telemetry
HLS content type is supported if a backend later provides a playlist; no paid transcoder or new AWS resources
Run focused regression tests plus automated TypeScript and release gates before any publish
Do not publish from an unverified DEV head; physical device verification is waived, not performed
preserveBehaviors: Existing Supabase RLS and short-lived signed URLs
Google IMA ad insertion and Reels inline ad slots
One active playing Reel and offscreen pause
Main production Expo Hosting web and EAS production OTA release gates
Main app version, native SDK runtime and Android package
